newsitem.title: USA: Ansys higher after GE contract news.
newsitem.headline: Ansys higher after GE contract news.

text.p: Ansys Inc's stock closed more than two points higher Tuesday after the company said in a press release that it won a $5.6 million, multi-year contract from General Electric Co to develop software and provide technical and consulting services.

Shortly after the company released the statement Tuesday, it sent an advisory asking news agencies to disregard it, claiming it was released prematurely. In a phone interview with Reuters, a company spokeswoman said the contract's "ink (was) not yet dry" and that Ansys expects to finalize the agreement with GE "within a few weeks."
"It was human error, pure and simple," said Laura Carrabine, the spokeswoman. "The wrong cover letter went on the wrong press statement."
Nonetheless, the company's stock -- which opened at 12-1/4 -- closed at a high for the day of 14-5/8 on the news, the company said.
